# autter_repository (Data Source)

A repository connected to the token's Autter organization, found by its full name or its short name. Its `id` is what resources take as `repository_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By full name (owner/repo), matched without regard to case.
data "autter_repository" "web" {
  full_name = "acme/web"
}

# By short name, when only one repository has it.
data "autter_repository" "api" {
  name = "api"
}

output "web_repository_id" {
  value = data.autter_repository.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `full_name` (String) `owner/repo`, matched without regard to case. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) The short name, as the dashboard shows it. Set this or `full_name`; it must be unique in the organization.

### Read-Only

- `default_branch` (String) The default branch, when known.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Autter is enabled for the repository.
- `id` (String) The repository's id.
